purpose: The few facts the Lab OS dashboard needs that are not machine-readable elsewhere in the repository: the status of each MASTER_CONTEXT section 37 step, the compute we have, and the key documents. Everything else in the dashboard is derived automatically from repository files by scripts/export_lab_state.py. Every entry here is cross-checked by tests/test_lab_state.py: step titles must equal MASTER_CONTEXT section 37, cited experiments/decisions must exist, a 'complete' step may only cite complete experiments and accepted decisions, and cited files must exist.

current_work.title: EXP-043 running (train the 14 x 896 model on Kaggle): sessions 1-2 done, lr 5e-4, main run at step 20,594 of 169,911; next: session 3 on both GPUs (D-050)
current_work.note: EXP-043 approved 2026-10-03 ("approve EXP-043"); code 2026-10-04: one-pass sampler (fixed SplitMix64 order, fingerprint checked every session), lr check {2.5e-4, 5e-4, 1e-3} x 6,104 steps with the pre-registered rule, main run 169,911 steps across Kaggle sessions with sha256-checked checkpoints passed between kernels -a/-b (kernel_sources, NOT VERIFIED on the account), stop rules, final evaluation. CPU: a split run gives bit-identical weights to one run. Fixed a RoPE KV-cache generation bug (training unaffected). Next: the founder runs scripts\run_kaggle_exp043.ps1 (session 1). About 85 GPU-h (NOT VERIFIED), cap 100, Rs 0. Session 1 (2026-10-04): lr check done, bpb 0.8543 / 0.8172 / 0.8160 at 2.5e-4 / 5e-4 / 1e-3, no skipped steps; 5e-4 chosen by the pre-registered rule (within noise 0.0174 of the best -> the lower one); 9.27 GB peak, about 11,100 tokens/s, 8.05 GPU-h used. Session 2 = first main-run session and first real kernel_sources chain test. D-050 approved 2026-10-04 ("APPROVE D-50") and built 2026-10-05: gpu_pretrain.py --gpus 2 (torchrun worker, 16 x 1 per GPU, process 0 decides and writes, fallback to one GPU if the start fails); the kernel passes --gpus 2. One-GPU path bit-identical (CPU smoke hashes); tests/test_pretrain_ddp.py 6 passed; full suite 748 passed, 1 skipped. Whole-session two-GPU speed NOT VERIFIED. Correction 2026-10-05: session 2 had not been launched; the code now keeps the first main-run session (no checkpoint yet) on one GPU even with --gpus 2 (D-050 point 2), so two GPUs start from session 3. Session 2 (2026-10-06, commit 37788c7, results 1eeca41): main run steps 0 -> 20,594 on one GPU, 11,115 tokens/s (1.474 s/step), 9.27 GB, 7 skipped steps, checkpoint step 20,594; session-end full validation 0.7727 bpb mean (mid-run, not a result); 16.72 of 100 session-h used. Session 3 = first checkpoint load from the other kernel and first two-GPU session.

current_work.title: Parallel work while EXP-043 runs: EXP-044 two-GPU check PASSED (1.79x, D-050 approved and built); EXP-045 evaluation code and EXP-046 step 1 ready
current_work.note: Founder 2026-10-04: "approve EXP-044, EXP-045, EXP-046". EXP-044 (step 13): DDP code with one-GPU behaviour unchanged (EXP-043 smoke hashes identical); CPU: 1 vs 2 processes give identical losses and weights (accumulation: 9.7e-17); the Kaggle check (about 1.5 GPU-h) runs between two EXP-043 sessions. EXP-045: Belebele (13 files pinned by hash), same-text bits, protected-suite bpb, 13-token contamination scan (Kaggle CPU, between EXP-043 sessions), everyday prompts, generate.py --interactive, fp16 copy; tests 1-3 and 5 run after EXP-043. EXP-046 step 1: data-1 + data-2 of the 13 languages pinned (26 files, 9,787,246,071 bytes; data-0 hashes cross-checked against slice 1; mal/data-1 is a half-size file, kept as pinned); the 15-minute probe (CPU, processes no data) runs between two EXP-043 sessions. Next: the build kernels, shaped by the probe's numbers. EXP-044 Kaggle check 2026-10-04 (commit 818bdf8): PASS on all rules: bpb 1.4319 (1 GPU) vs 1.4276 (2 GPUs), difference 0.0042 <= 0.01; 12,225 vs 21,882 tokens/s = 1.79x >= 1.4x; 8.98 GB per GPU; 0 skipped steps. D-050 proposed: the rest of the EXP-043 main run on both GPUs from the first session after it is built (session 2 stays on one GPU).
